# Project Assessment Model

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

This model defines what must be evaluated about a project to produce a defensible artifact prescription. It combines PMBOK tailoring factors with business analysis assessment areas.

## Assessment Dimensions

### 1. Problem or Opportunity

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| What problem does the project solve or what opportunity does it capture? | Situation statement, business case, problem statement |
| Who identified it and why now? | Origin, trigger, authorization record |
| What happens if the project does not proceed? | Impact analysis, do-nothing scenario |

### 2. Current State

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| What capabilities and processes exist today? | Current-state assessment, process documentation, operational data |
| What are the known gaps and pain points? | Issue logs, feedback, performance data |
| What constraints exist (budget, timeline, policy, regulation)? | Organizational standards, regulatory obligations, agreements |

### 3. Desired Future State

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| What outcomes, capabilities, and features are desired? | Vision statement, goals and objectives, feature list |
| How will success be measured? | Success criteria, KPIs, benefits description |
| What is the delivery timeframe? | Milestone list, schedule, roadmap |

### 4. Project Profile (PMBOK Tailoring Factors)

| Factor | Values | Relevance |
|--------|--------|-----------|
| Project size | Small, Medium, Large | Determines governance weight and formality |
| Development approach | Predictive, Adaptive, Hybrid | Shapes artifact selection and timing |
| Industry | Technology, Construction, Healthcare, Finance, Creative, Regulated, Other | Regulatory and compliance implications |
| Organizational culture | Hierarchical, Flat, Collaborative | Affects approval and engagement artifacts |
| Team distribution | Colocated, Distributed, Remote | Communication and coordination artifacts |
| Risk level | Low, Medium, High | Risk management artifact depth |
| Stakeholder complexity | Few and aligned, Many and conflicting | Engagement and communication artifacts |
| Regulatory environment | None, Moderate, Heavy | Compliance and control artifacts |
| Technology maturity | Proven, Emerging, Experimental | Feasibility and planning artifacts |
| Project duration | Weeks, Months, Years | Planning horizon and control artifacts |
| AI integration level | None, Assisting, Delegated | Which artifacts must be maintained as records versus generated on demand |

### 5. BA Planning and Approach

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| Is there a defined business analysis approach? | BA plan, approach document |
| Who performs BA activities? | Role definitions, resource assignments |
| How are requirements elicited and managed? | Elicitation plan, requirements process |
| What traceability and monitoring practices exist? | Traceability matrix, change process |

### 6. Stakeholders and Engagement

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| Who are the key stakeholders and decision makers? | Stakeholder register, org chart, RACI |
| How are they engaged? | Engagement plan, communication plan |
| What is the decision-making process? | Decision log, governance framework, escalation matrix |

### 7. Scope and Requirements

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| What is in scope and out of scope? | Scope statement, requirements documents |
| How are requirements documented and approved? | Requirements baseline, approval records |
| What is the requirements stability? | Change requests, volatility analysis |

### 8. Schedule and Delivery

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| What is the delivery approach and cadence? | Schedule, milestone plan, release plan |
| How is progress tracked? | Status reports, burn charts, EVM data |
| What are the key milestones and dependencies? | Milestone list, dependency map |

### 9. Finance and Benefits

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| What is the budget and cost baseline? | Budget, cost estimates, funding documents |
| How are costs tracked and reported? | Financial reports, variance analysis |
| What benefits are expected and how will they be measured? | Benefits management plan, business case |

### 10. Resources and Organization

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| Who is on the team and what are their roles? | Resource assignments, RACI, team directory |
| What physical and material resources are needed? | Resource requirements, procurement documentation |
| What training and onboarding is planned? | Training plan, skill assessments |

### 11. Risk, Controls, and Compliance

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| What are the key risks and how are they managed? | Risk register, risk response plan, issue log |
| What controls and compliance requirements exist? | Regulatory documentation, audit reports, quality records |
| How are changes controlled? | Change control process, change log |

### 12. Software Delivery (for software application projects)

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| Does the project deliver or modify a software application? | Project description, scope statement, requirements |
| What is the delivery target (prototype, pilot, production)? | Stage definition, release plan, milestone list |
| What is the target platform and technology stack? | Technical requirements, architecture notes, team expertise |
| What integrations with other systems are required? | Dependency register, integration specification |
| What data sensitivity and security requirements exist? | Data classification, security policy, compliance obligations |
| Who is the target user group? | Stakeholder register, user research |
| What authentication, hosting, and operational requirements exist? | Infrastructure plan, operations guide, access policies |
| What development artifacts exist already? | Source inventory, existing documentation |

### 13. Solution Evaluation

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| How will solution performance be evaluated? | Evaluation approach, success criteria |
| What acceptance processes exist? | Acceptance criteria, sign-off records |
| What transition and operational readiness is planned? | Transition plan, operational readiness assessment |

### 14. Information and AI Environment

| Question | Evidence Needed |
|----------|-----------------|
| Which records are the authoritative sources of truth today? | System-of-record list, existing registers |
| Where does AI draft, summarize, or generate content? | AI usage notes, workflows, prompts |
| Where do humans review and approve AI output? | Approval points, review workflow |
| What retention and security requirements apply to project information? | Data classification, retention policy |
| How fresh must project information be? | Reporting cadence, decision deadlines |
| What happens to AI output when source records change? | Versioning and regeneration practice |

## Applying the Model

1. No single project will have evidence for all dimensions.
2. Document what is found, what is missing, and what is assumed.
3. Use confidence labels from evidence-standards.md.
4. Let evidence depth determine prescription formality, not the other way around.
